next.reason: 1985: "An EXIT PROGRAM statement must not be executed while executing within the range of a declarative procedure in which the GLOBAL phrase"; 2023: "The EXIT statement shall not be specified in a declarative procedure for which the GLOBAL phrase is specified in the associated USE". 1985 bars executing EXIT PROGRAM anywhere in a GLOBAL declarative's range. 2023 bars writing any EXIT form in that declarative, so code performed from outside it is not covered.
